intro: We are always looking for motivated people who want to build spatial AI systems that run in the real world, in real time.

openings.details: Fully-funded positions in relevant areas are available. Strong hands-on experience in robotics, embedded systems, etc. preferred.
openings.about: Please refer to NTU's website for the relevant application procedures. https://www.ntu.edu.sg/admissions/graduate/radmissionguide

openings.details: NTU FYP/URECA applicants welcome to write in. Prior hands-on experience preferred, research/publication experience not mandated.
openings.about: Generally, project durations will follow typical administrative requirements (i.e. 2 semesters). If you have a specific topic or area of interest, or want mentorship from a particular member, please specify that in your email.

howToApply: Email your CV, transcripts, and a short statement of interest to the address below, with the subject line shown beside it. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
subject: EIAS Application
note: We especially welcome applicants with hands-on robotics or embedded systems experience.
